pkgmetadata.longdescription: AMD's own debugging tools for Zen platforms, written at AMD by Mario Limonciello. They ship in the AMD Ryzen AI Developer Platform image: amd-s2idle (analyze entry into and exit from suspend-to-idle), amd-bios (toggle BIOS AML debug logging and parse it from the kernel log), amd-pstate (capture amd-pstate driver and MSR state for triage) and amd-ttm (query and change the TTM pages_limit, i.e. how much system memory the GPU of an APU may use).

use.flag: Read the kernel log from the systemd journal through dev-python/python-systemd instead of dmesg
